notes: The authors state that threshold classifications and cross-season comparisons are descriptive, not statistical, so no tests are recorded. The credible intervals in Figure 2 carry no conclusions. NIS coverage and the 68% VE are cited from other sources, not analyzed.
view_issues: The Abstract says 2022–23 incidence for children <5 years was similar to previous seasons, while the Discussion says it was higher than most previous seasons.
